listing.name: Transponder Reminders
listing.summary: Ever lost rep because you forgot to turn on your transponder before jumping into a friendly system?
listing.aiSummary: Adds an option to automatically activate the transponder when jumping to friendly systems and optionally deactivate it when jumping to hyperspace.

description:
Download
Git repository

Ever lost rep because you forgot to turn on your transponder before jumping into a friendly system? Transponder Reminders is a mini-mod that adds an option to jump points leading to friendly systems1 that activates your transponder while jumping, and (optionally) to deactivate your transponder when jumping to hyperspace. If you normally prefer to keep your transponder on in hyperspace, you can disable the prompt to turn it off by setting "promptToDeactivateInHyperspace": false in transponder-reminders_settings.json.

1: Precisely, it prompts you if the system contains a market that is not already hostile and belongs to a faction whose patrols conduct transponder checks.

aiDescription: Adds an option to automatically activate the transponder when jumping to friendly systems and optionally deactivate it when jumping to hyperspace. This helps prevent reputation loss from forgetting to turn on the transponder before entering friendly territory. The hyperspace deactivation prompt can be disabled via a configuration setting.
